mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates accommodative monetary policy, which reduces discount rates and increases equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances with FEDFUNDS below 0.5%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 8.0% signals economic weakness and reduced consumer spending, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE > 8.0%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of high unemployment (UNRATE) and declining consumer spending (RSAFS) signals a deepening economic slowdown, which triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE > 8.0% and RSAFS declines, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, a high federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates an active monetary tightening cycle, which compresses equity valuations and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances during late-cycle expansion with FEDFUNDS above 1.0%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) over the past 3 months signals robust manufacturing activity, which supports corporate earnings growth and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances with rising INDPRO, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in housing starts (HOUST) over the past 3 months indicates a strengthening housing market, which boosts consumer confidence and corporate revenues, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 60% of instances with rising HOUST, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the federal funds rate above 0.5% signals an active monetary tightening cycle, which increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 0.5%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in industrial production (INDPRO) signals strong manufacturing growth, which supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of instances with rising INDPRO, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
